verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The Copilot admin controls (access, Strict mode, deletion blocking) are adjacent permission features, not telemetry opt-outs, and email tracking concerns customer engagement rather than product telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
